canonical_name: Moore-Penrose inverse existence and uniqueness for finite rectangular complex matrices
literal_source_claim_zh: 任意矩阵的广义逆存在唯一
literal_source_claim_en: Every matrix has a unique generalized inverse.
statement_blocker: The catalog does not define generalized inverse. It omits the four Moore-Penrose equations, the complex or real scalar choice, finite rectangular dimensions and index types, conjugate-transpose convention, multiplication typing, and empty-dimension behavior. The inspected Penrose Theorem 1 is a strong primary-source lead, but catalog-source identity, the joint Moore attribution, immutable preservation, corrections, transcription, and independent review remain open. Selecting an exact Lean proposition at intake would invent source-identifying mathematics.
